name: instagram-agent
description: AI agent that plans, drafts, generates assets for, and publishes Instagram content with human approvals and a React dashboard.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @instagram-agent/shared dev & pnpm --filter server dev & pnpm --filter client dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @instagram-agent/shared build && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @instagram-agent/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter client typecheck
